title: Complaint Of Miss T.E. Boulgakova Against Former Lover M.I. Elkes

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 20,000-1-30

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

MUNICIPAL
File No.
REGISTRY
4377
Boarding House Section Station,
Date December 30, 19 32.

Subject (in full) Attached complaint

Made by D.I. Schmidt Forwarded by Supt. Quayle

Sir,
Reference attached complaint, inquiries show that the
French Police, have received an exact copy of complainant's
letter and with the assistance of the French Police, the com-
plainant Miss. T. F. Boulgakova, was located and interviewed
by D.S. Massiukoff at 698 Rue Bourgeat (the number 689 given in
attached letter is an error).
Complainant's story is the usual lover's quarrel. It is
correct that she has been beaten on several occasions by her
lover M. I. Elkes, but had refused to prosecute him.
Complainant has been a resident of the French Concession
for the last six months, and as according to complainant, Elkes
(the lover) is in the habit of coming to her home in the French
Concession to cause trouble, the French Police requested assis-
tance to visit 34 Haskell Road to interview Elkes.
At 9.40 a.m. December 30, the undersigned accompanied
by D.S. Massiukoff and French Detective Lyapin, visited 34 Has-
kell Road, interviewed Michael I. Elkes and warned him not to
molest complainant in future. He was also strongly advised that
the Court, was the best place to settle the dispute regarding
the guardianship of the child.

Yours obediently

H. J. Schmidt
D.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

工部局
档案编号
登记处
4377
寄宿舍股分站，
日期 1932年12月30日。

事由（全称） 附呈之投诉书

由警探长 Schmidt 提交 经警司 Quayle 转呈

先生：
关于附呈之投诉书，经查询，法国巡捕房已收到投诉人信函的确切副本，并在法国巡捕房的协助下，投诉人 T. F. Boulgakova 小姐于布尔热路（Rue Bourgeat）698号被找到并由侦探员 Massiukoff 进行了问话（附信中给出的689号系误写）。
投诉人所称之事乃寻常之情侣纠纷。确有其事的是，她曾多次被其情人 M. I. Elkes 殴打，但拒绝对他提起诉讼。
投诉人在过去六个月中一直居住于法租界，且据投诉人称，Elkes（该情人）惯常前往其在法租界的住所滋事，故法国巡捕房请求协助，前往哈斯克尔路34号对 Elkes 进行问话。
12月30日上午9时40分，具名者会同侦探员 Massiukoff 及法国侦探 Lyapin，前往哈斯克尔路34号，问话了 Michael I. Elkes，并警告他今后不得骚扰投诉人。此外，还强烈建议他，关于子女监护权的争议，诉诸法庭乃是解决此事的最佳途径。

此致
敬礼

H. J. Schmidt
警探长
